SELECT st.* FROM seat st WHERE st.hall_id = #{hallId} ORDER BY st.row_number, st.seat_number, st.id

SELECT DISTINCT ss.seat_id, ss.status FROM screening s JOIN screening_seat ss ON ss.screening_id = s.id WHERE s.hall_id = #{hallId} AND s.status NOT IN (3, 4) AND s.end_time > #{now} AND ss.status IN (1, 2)
